title: First paying riders
notes: Brief says March 2027; 1 March used for the countdown.

title: Insurance in place
why: Public liability cover that names paying riders on the rig. No cover, no sales.

title: Safety inspector booked
why: A confirmed date with an ADIPS ride safety inspector.

title: Software licences signed
why: Commercial permission for at least one flight game and one driving game.

title: Bookings and payments working
why: Customers can choose, pay and get a voucher code. Proven with a real test purchase.

title: Terms and conditions ready
why: The small print for vouchers and bookings, checked by a solicitor.

title: Ride safety certificate issued
why: The ADIPS inspector's sign-off (the DOC) that the rig is safe for the public.
